title: THE FIVE-YEAR RECKONING
narrative: Through the heart-tree, Bran weaves time backward and forward, mending the fractured chronology that broke George's outline in 2003. In the tree's vision, years pass in an eyeblink: Arya matures from an eleven-year-old child into an eighteen-year-old water-dancer of deadly grace. Jon's beard thickens with frost and veteran command. The dragons swell from horse-sized lizards into mountain-crushing titans. The timeline is healed — no more children commanding continental armies.

options.text: Face the Night King in single combat at the Battle of the Dawn.
Send Arya through the shadow of the weirwoods to end the war.
